extracted.name: Apple Chutney
extracted.description: Homemade apple chutney made with apples, onions, vinegar, sugar, and fresh ginger for a delicious relish with roast pork or condiment for cheese.
ingredient_lines: 15 tart apples - peeled, cored, and finely chopped
3 (1 inch) pieces fresh ginger root, peeled
instruction_lines: Place apples, raisins, onion, ginger, water, white sugar, brown sugar, cinnamon, cardamom, pepper, and nutmeg into a large saucepan; bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring often.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer, stirring frequently, until apples are tender, about 30 minutes.
Stir and continue simmering, uncovered, until slightly thickened, about 15 minutes more. Remove from heat; discard onion and ginger for smoother consistency. Stir in white wine vinegar.

Let chutney cool at least 2 hours at room temperature then transfer into a sterilized jar or container. Seal by canning in boiling water bath, and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks until ready to serve.
